def try_syntax_from_message(message):
    """
    Parse the try syntax out of a commit message, returning '' if none is
    found.
    """
    try_idx = message.find("try:")
    if try_idx == -1:
        return ""
    return message[try_idx:].split("\n", 1)[0]
